name: Cut the Snares
offerText: What are the goblins doing up there?
description: They're snaring wolves in the hills. Cut every snare you find.
completionText: Fewer wolves for their riders, then.

name: First In
description: The goblins keep their worgs penned just inside. Kill them before they're turned loose on the forest.
completionText: The pens are quiet. Hale will want to hear it.

name: New at the Outpost
offerText: I'm new here. Where do I start?
description: Ranger Hale runs the outpost. Find Hale by the stockade; there's always work.
completionText: Ives sent you? Good. I can use the help.

name: Something Behind Them
description: Go up into the hills and see what's driving the beasts. Watch for goblin sneaks; they've been seen.
completionText: Goblins. I was afraid of that.

objectives.text: Kill 5 Goblin Sneaks in The Hills

name: The Boar Run
description: The boars are stampeding toward the woodcutters' camp. Cull the herd on the boar run before they trample someone.
completionText: The woodcutters will sleep better.

name: The Cub
description: The riders keep wolf cubs penned in the hills, to break them young. Open the cages and let them go.
completionText: Free, and back to their packs. Well done.

name: The Mouth
description: Follow them to the cave mouth at the top of the hills. My scout Arlo is camped just inside. Find him.
completionText: Hale sent you? Then you're with me.

name: Too Close
description: Wolves have been coming up the north track, bold as dogs. Thin them out before someone gets bitten.
completionText: That'll keep them off the track. For now.

name: Tracks
offerText: Where are the wolves coming from?
description: Read the tracks along the boar run, by the woodcutters. I want to know which way they're coming from.
completionText: From the hills, all of them. Something's pushing them down.

name: Wolfriders
description: Goblins riding captured wolves patrol the hills. Bring their numbers down.
completionText: That should slow their patrols.

objectives.text: Kill 5 Goblin Wolfriders in Wolfrider Run

name: Blackscale Raiders
description: Blackscale warriors still prowl the nesting grounds. Drive them off.
completionText: The nests are ours again.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Blackscale Warriors in Burned Nests

name: Burned Nests
description: Search the burned nests at the nesting grounds. Tell me what you find among the ashes.
completionText: Blackscale spears. As I feared.

name: Captives
description: They hold our people in pens behind their east camp. Open the pens.
completionText: They're home. All of them. Thank you.

name: Into Blackscale Land
offerText: How do we reach the war-shaman?
description: Their village is beyond the marsh. Break the warriors at its heart.
completionText: Their village reels. Now the shaman.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Blackscale Warriors in Blackscale Village

name: Prove It
description: Vipers on the south path and frogs at the nesting grounds. Clear them and I'll believe you can hold a spear.
completionText: Good. You hunt like one of us. Almost.

objectives.text: Kill 4 Swamp Vipers in Reedtalker Village
Kill 4 Giant Frogs in Nesting Grounds

name: Smoke Ends
description: In the hut at the far end of their village. End this.
completionText: The smoke ends. You have a home among us, human.

name: Smoke over the Mire
offerText: What's that smoke to the south?
description: Smoke over the mire, three days now. The lizardfolk there, the Reedtalkers, keep to themselves. Go and see what's burning.
completionText: A human. You came about the smoke? Then sit.

name: The War-Shaman
description: Someone gives the Blackscales orders. Their hunters in the raider camps will know. Make them pay for knowing.
completionText: A war-shaman, then. In their village.

objectives.text: Kill 6 Blackscale Hunters in East Raider Camp

name: Their Totems
description: War-totems on the trail into their marsh, tended by a shaman. Topple the totems and kill the shaman who keeps them.
completionText: Without their totems, their courage will waver.

name: Wary Welcome
offerText: How can I help your people?
description: Words are cheap. Speak with Kesh, our hunter. If Kesh will work with you, so will I.
completionText: Sesh sent you to me? Then let's see you hunt.

name: Break the Gathering
description: Smash their war drums and cut down their warriors. No drums, no gathering.
completionText: The halls are in chaos. Good.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Goblin Cutters in Drum Hall

name: Collapse Them
offerText: How do we close the tunnels?
description: Knock out the props in the new tunnels and let the rock do the rest. Then report to Captain Rhys, past the fungus deeps.
completionText: Arlo's work? Good. I can use you.

name: Deeper
description: The goblins are digging somewhere below. Go deeper, into the tunnels, and see.
completionText: Sapper tunnels. Toward the surface.

name: Grutt's Hall
description: Warboss Grutt's hall lies past the drum halls. Find the way in.
completionText: His hall. Guarded, of course.

name: Guards
description: Too many. Thin out Grutt's archers and cutters.
completionText: The way to Grutt is open.

objectives.text: Kill 6 Goblin Archers in Guards' Approach
Kill 6 Goblin Cutters in Guards' Approach

name: Mushroom Farms
offerText: How do the goblins eat down here?
description: Their mushroom farms feed the whole warband. Burn the beds.
completionText: Hungry goblins fight worse.

name: Sapper Tunnels
description: Sappers are digging new tunnels toward the forest. Kill them while they're at it.
completionText: That'll slow the digging.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Goblin Sappers in New Tunnels

name: The Goblin King
description: The Goblin King, in his hall below. Go down and end it.
completionText: The King is dead. The caves are ours to clear.

name: The Hexer
description: A goblin hexer named Nagg curses every step we take. Nagg dens in the fungus deeps. Kill the hexer.
completionText: The air feels lighter already.

name: The Sealed Stair
description: A sealed stair behind Grutt's throne. Break the seal.
completionText: The way down is open. Whatever's down there...

name: The Shaman's Fire
description: Brazza, Keeper of the Fire, blesses their raids. Put out that fire for good.
completionText: Their blessings are ash.

objectives.text: Kill Brazza, Keeper of the Fire

name: The Wolf-Master
description: The wolf-master holds the drum hall's floor. Kill the wolf-master and the riders scatter.
completionText: No more riders in the hills.

name: War Drums
description: The tribes are gathering at the drum halls. Go and look.
completionText: All the tribes, in one hall. Grutt's doing.

name: Warboss Grutt
description: Kill Warboss Grutt on his throne. End his war.
completionText: Grutt's dead. But these orders... they came from below.

name: In
offerText: Is anyone still in the caves?
description: Mags was with Maren. Go in through the flooded caves and find her.
completionText: Water's cold. Goblins are colder. But you found me.

name: Maren Holt
description: Maren Holt is held in Grutt's hall. Force the cell door.
completionText: You came. I didn't think anyone would.

name: Overdue
description: A prospecting expedition went north for silver and never came back. Search their camp on the pine ridge.
completionText: Abandoned in a hurry. They went into the hills.

name: Reedtalker Rescue
description: Cole was hurt. The Reedtalkers took him in. Find him in their village.
completionText: They took me in. I owe them.

name: South
description: Dana led the ones who went south. Find Dana in the mire.
completionText: You came from the outpost? Thank the stars.

name: Split Up
description: Goblins hunted us. They're still hunting me. Kill the sneaks near my hide and I'll tell you everything.
completionText: We split up. Half went south to the mire, half went into the caves.

objectives.text: Kill 5 Goblin Sneaks in The Hills

name: The First Survivor
description: Someone's been lighting small fires in the hills, south and west. Find whoever it is.
completionText: You're from the outpost? Keep your voice down.

name: The Flooded Way
offerText: Where did the rest go in?
description: Through the flooded cave mouth at the blackwater pools. Crocodiles hunt there; clear them.
completionText: The way in is clear.

objectives.text: Kill 4 Swamp Crocodiles in Flooded Cave Mouth

name: The Silver Seam
description: We found it, and it's why the goblins came. Chip samples from the silver seam; Ives will want proof.
completionText: Proof. The expedition wasn't for nothing.

name: Wolves at the Woodpile
description: Wolves keep coming into camp after the scraps. Drive them off.
completionText: Back to work, then.

name: Sapper's Charges
description: The sappers' blasting charges. Steal some from their camp.
completionText: Good. Now let's use them.

name: Seal the Tunnel
description: Set them at the face of the new tunnel and bring it down.
completionText: That tunnel won't reach the forest.

objectives.text: Set the charges at the Tunnel Face

name: The Lost Lantern
description: My lantern, in the glowworm grotto. It was Maren's. Please.
completionText: Maren's lantern. Thank you.

name: Hexed Totems
description: Three hexed totems in the drum hall spread it. Break them.
completionText: The air clears.

name: Sick Tunnels
description: Something's sickened the spiders by the farms. Kill the sick ones before it spreads.
completionText: Their sickness... it's a hex.

objectives.text: Kill 6 Cave Spiders in Mushroom Farms

name: The Apprentice
description: Nagg's apprentices, in the hexer's den. Kill them.
completionText: No more hexes in these tunnels.

objectives.text: Kill 3 Goblin Hexers in Hexer's Den

name: Lost Snares
description: My snares in the tall grass by the camp. Collect them before the beasts tear them up.
completionText: All of them? Good.

name: What's Caught
description: Plenty, and angry about it. Deal with what's thrashing in the snare lines.
completionText: Safe to walk the lines again.

name: Stalked
description: Something big takes deer near the boggy hollow. Look at the kills and tell me what did it.
completionText: A black panther. I knew it.

name: The Black Panther
description: Hunt the black panther in its den, before it hunts us.
completionText: The camps can breathe again.

name: The Woodcutter's Axe
description: My axe! I dropped it running from a bear. It's in the bear's den now, with the bear.
completionText: My axe! Bless you.

name: The Abandoned Camp
description: There's an abandoned camp up on the pine ridge. Search it and see who left it.
completionText: Ranger gear. Hale should see this.

name: What's There Now
description: Dire wolves den in it now. Clear them out.
completionText: Rest easy, old friends.

objectives.text: Kill 5 Dire Wolves in Abandoned Camp

name: Who Left It
description: Bring what you found to Ranger Hale.
completionText: My old patrol's camp. They never came back.

name: A Reedtalker Cure
description: The Reedtalkers' healer, Sura, knows a cure. Ask Sura.
completionText: I can stand again. Thank you.

name: Fever Herbs
description: Fever... feverleaf, in the herb patches. Please.
completionText: That's... better. A little.

name: Keep Them Off
description: They will. Thin out the frogs at their nests.
completionText: Let them try now.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Giant Frogs in Frog Nests

name: Stolen Eggs
description: The frogs took our eggs to their nests. Bring the clutches back.
completionText: The eggs, safe. Safe.

name: The Sunken Idol
description: Our idol was lost in the deep pool. Lift it out.
completionText: The idol watches again.

name: Taken Fishers
description: Crocodiles took three of ours at the pools. Kill the crocodiles there.
completionText: Fewer jaws in the water.

objectives.text: Kill 5 Swamp Crocodiles in The Deep Pool

name: The Old Croc
description: The Old Croc, huge and old, wallows past the pools. Kill it.
completionText: The water is ours again.
